meaning: A separately versioned Lean proof unit represents complete reconciled graph and authored selection data and checks finite structural references without coercing new typed contracts into legacy shapes.
input: Construct only from a registered unchanged compiled graph and matching registered reconciled plan, using the lossless verification projection. Full root-independent graph and authored selection remain inspectable data, not opaque digests.
representation: Recursive tagged values distinguish null, booleans, canonical finite numbers, UTF-16 code-unit strings, ordered lists, and canonically ordered object entries. This preserves astral characters, lone surrogates, control characters, array order, field constructors, expressions, occurrence identities and exact numeric strings. Keys and user values cannot become Lean syntax.
kernel_checks: unique complete node selectors and qualified endpoint identity/kind
relationship endpoints allowed by the frozen signature catalog
Workflow step/compensation Operation references and occurrence-to-authored-binding coverage
named Interface operation references and public Mapping target contract identity
typed State Machine initial/source/target states, trigger Event, guard Rule and output Event references
proof_ceiling: Only the named finite structural predicates over the represented graph and selection. No proof of arithmetic evaluation, Rule semantics, transaction behavior, provider execution, native-code conformance or all DS-D8 obligations. Preserve all stronger verification evidence requirements; do not report formal or native verification from construction.
output: Pure immutable registered bundle with complete verification input, fixed filename, deterministic self-contained Lean source, exact source digest, definition digest, projection digest, explicit checked predicate list and unexecuted status. Validation reconstructs all bytes from checked graph/plan; forged or altered bundles reject.
verification: Lean 4.33.1 must compile the concrete proof unit with kernel reduction proofs and no sorry, added axiom declarations or native_decide. Audit the theorem dependencies: only Lean standard foundations propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound are permitted; no project-specific assumption, sorryAx or native decision oracle is permitted. This is not an axiom-free proof claim. Independently evaluated Lean data must round-trip to the source graph and selection. Well-formed proof-source mutants changing structural references must fail kernel checking, not just hash validation.
compatibility: Keep legacy formalizer, its guards, historical source pins and CLI rejection unchanged until complete successor execution and aggregation are implemented. No SFOL syntax redesign.
